notes: The three italicized *there be* clusters are folded onto their predicate nouns under rules 68 and 96: an existential expletive is a supplied subject decided by what is left in the clause to carry it, and each εἴτε clause leaves only its noun; rule 11 keeps the italics from settling the status.
οὐδέποτε takes the whole *never* as its own aligned unit; no second negator stands in the clause, so rule 41 is not in play.
The two καταργέω futures head on *done*, with *away* riding inside each verb's own unit, matching 1CO.13.11's *put away* for the same lemma (rule 24).
